name: BRUNEI

lead: Brunei is a tiny country on the island of Borneo. It is smaller than the US state of Delaware. Oil makes it wealthy. Thick rainforest hides proboscis monkeys. A golden mosque glows beside its own lagoon.

sections.animals: Monkeys and birds in the trees
sections.history: From old empire to oil riches
sections.wows: 7 things to make you go wow

geo: Brunei sits on the north coast of Borneo. Malaysia's Sarawak splits it into two pieces. A thin plain runs along the South China Sea. Then the land climbs into misty jungle.
Two-thirds of Brunei is untouched rainforest. Workers found oil at Seria in 1929. It changed the country.
animals: The proboscis monkey lives only on Borneo. It has a big nose and a round tummy. At dusk it swims rivers and crashes through mangroves (trees in salty water).
Ulu Temburong park shelters pygmy elephants and sun bears. The rhinoceros hornbill is the national bird. Its red-and-yellow casque (a big bump) looks like a banana glued to its beak.
culture: Most people in Brunei follow Islam. Mosques call people to prayer five times a day. At Hari Raya, a holiday feast, the Sultan (the king) opens his palace to thousands of visitors.
Kampong Ayer is the Water Village. About 13,000 people live there on stilts over the Brunei River. 36 km of walkways link the houses.
history: Brunei's sultanate began in the 14th century. It once ruled much of Borneo and the Philippines. In 1521, Magellan's crew saw a court of gold and cannon. In 1888 it became a British protectorate (under British protection).
Japan occupied Brunei from 1941 to 1945. A revolt failed in 1962. The Sultan then kept Brunei out of Malaysia. Brunei became fully independent on 1 January 1984.
wows: Citizens pay no income tax, because oil pays for government.
The Sultan's palace has 1,788 rooms, the biggest royal home on Earth.
One royal family has ruled for 600+ years.
Brunei is the only fully independent country entirely on Borneo.
Citizens get free healthcare and free university.
Only boats reached Temburong until a 30 km bridge opened in 2020.
Ambuyat, a gluey paste, is Brunei's favourite dish.

myths.myth: Borneo is the biggest island on Earth
myths.fact: Greenland is the biggest island, then New Guinea. Borneo is third.
Most oil comes from tiny sea plants and animals that died millions of years ago.
